18 empty cells are left.
17 of them have only two notes.
Only the red cell has three notes: 2, 3 and 4.
Look at the red cell's row 5,
column 1 and box 4.
Note 3 appears twice
in each of the three.
Note 4 also appears twice
in each of the three.
Note 2 appears three times
in each of the three.
만약 빨간 칸이 2가 아니라면\n빈칸이 모두 메모가 두 숫자뿐이고\n모든:
If the red cell were not 2,
every empty cell would have only two notes,
and in every row, column and box
each note would appear twice.
그러면 답이 두 개가 됩니다.\n스도쿠의 답은 하나뿐이라\n이렇게 될 수:
Then there would be two answers.
A sudoku has only one answer,
so this can't happen.
빈칸마다 메모 숫자가 몇 개인지 보세요.\n답을 바로 정할 수 있는 칸을:
Count the notes in each empty cell.
Tap the cell you can settle right away.
That cell has only two notes.
Look for a cell with three notes.
That cell already has a digit.
Look at the empty cells with notes.
맞아요. 이 칸의 가로줄, 세로줄, 박스에서\n메모 6이 세 번씩 나와요:
Right. Note 6 appears three times in this cell's
row, column and box. This cell is 6.
1. 메모가 세 숫자인 칸을 찾고\n나머지 빈칸이 모두 두 숫자뿐인지 확:
1. Find the cell with three notes and check
that every other empty cell has only two.
2. 그 칸의 가로줄, 세로줄, 박스에서\n세 번씩 나오는 숫자를 넣습니:
2. Put in the digit that appears three times
in that cell's row, column and box.
빈칸이 모두 메모가 두 숫자뿐인 판을\nBUG라고 합니다.\n한 칸만 숫:
A board where every empty cell has only two notes is called a BUG.
Here just one cell has one extra note, so it is called BUG+1.
